What the app does

Live webcam tracking

MediaPipe draws a skeleton on your video and tracks movement in real time.

Form scoring

Joint angles are compared to the target pose so you know when form is off.

Voice and on-screen tips

Short cues like “bend your knee more” while you are in the session.

Session history

Dashboard shows streaks, weekly charts, and past workout stats.

How it works

01

Start camera

Allow webcam access in the browser. Nothing gets uploaded.

02

Pick an exercise

Choose from fitness moves, yoga poses, or desk stretches.

03

Follow the overlay

Skeleton tracking and form tips show up on the video feed.

04

Save the session

Stop when done — reps, time, and accuracy go to your dashboard.
